text:
maria: FYI got a ticket from a customer — trial credits granted but they can't see them in their active org. customer says credits are attached to an old/archived org named 'acme-corp-archive' (they think it's a clone from an SSO migration). can someone confirm where the credits landed?
jamal: can you paste the customer org id + email? also any SSO migration notes?
maria: org_reported: acme-prod (org_id: org_01A2B3C4). from support notes: user said they completed SSO mapping last month and we deactivated the old workspace. customer email: ops+trial@acme.com. ticket#: 23218.
alex: running a quick lookup on the backend. hop in a sec.
alex: admin command i ran: `rw-admin org credits list --org-name "acme" --include-archived`
alex: output (sanitized):
```
archived_org: org_0099ARCHIVED  balance: 500.00  grants: [{id: grant_778, type: trial, created_by: system}]
active_org: org_01A2B3C4  balance: 0.00  grants: []
```
alex: confirms credits are attached to archived org id org_0099ARCHIVED. looks like auto-grant hit the archived id (likely from org name collision during SSO migration). :eyes:
katie: ugh, we've seen this pattern — when an org is archived but has similar slug/name the grant pipeline matched the wrong record. we have a safe transfer tool: `rw-admin credits transfer` that keeps audit trail.
katie: proposed command (needs CS approval + idempotency key):
```
rw-admin credits transfer --from org_0099ARCHIVED --to org_01A2B3C4 --amount 500 --reason "trial-misapplied-after-sso" --idempotency-key trial-23218-2026-03-17
```
maria: customer wants it moved ASAP, they authorized us to proceed. tagging @jamal to confirm.
jamal: go ahead, please include a note in the ticket. ask eng to run it during low-traffic window; also want an audit export before we change anything.
katie: grabbing audit export now.
katie: audit export snippet: `SELECT id, event, actor, timestamp FROM credits_audit WHERE org_id = 'org_0099ARCHIVED' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20;`
katie: sample rows: `grant_778, create_grant, system, 2026-03-15T14:12:03Z`
katie: transfer started by eng-runbook at 16:34 UTC. i'll run the transfer and paste output here.
billing-bot: Transfer job queued: job_id=job_5532 status=PENDING (initiated by katie)
katie: running...
katie: transfer command completed:
```
job_5532: status=SUCCESS transferred=500.00 from=org_0099ARCHIVED to=org_01A2B3C4 tx_id=tx_9921
```
billing-bot: job_5532 finished at 2026-03-17T16:39:04Z. audit_id=aud_2244
maria: confirmed with internal lookup: live balance for org_01A2B3C4 is now 500.00. forwarding to customer.
maria: notes to customer (copy): "We've located your trial credit grant on an archived workspace created during your prior SSO migration. We've moved the full 500 credits to your active org (org_01A2B3C4). You should see them available immediately. We've also added an audit entry for traceability. If you'd like, we can verify SSO mappings to prevent recurrence." :thumbsup:
jamal: follow up action: eng to add a check in grant pipeline to prefer non-archived orgs when names collide. filing an engineering issue.
katie: filing GH issue: `infra/credits#1245` with repro steps + mitigation.
maria: closing ticket pending customer ack. leaving note to run a weekly scan to surface any other grants stuck on archived orgs.
